answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the marble of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The shale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the trellis. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
